subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Which permanent Telegram album API should OpenClaw support for this issue: album semantics on existing `mediaUrls` paths, the external draft's new `send-media-group`/`filePaths` action, or no native album guarantee for now?
rationale: The missing behavior is source-confirmed, but the public action shape and cross-path semantics are product/API decisions that cleanup automation should not choose while an external draft with closing syntax is open.

options.title: Use existing mediaUrls semantics
options.body: Add `sendMediaGroup` as a Telegram delivery optimization for existing structured multi-media payloads and keep sequential fallback for unsupported cases.

options.title: Adopt the draft action
options.body: Review and reshape the external draft's `send-media-group`/`filePaths` surface as the supported model-facing action contract.

options.title: Defer native albums
options.body: Keep sequential fanout as the supported behavior and document that Telegram albums are not currently guaranteed.

recommendation.title: Use existing mediaUrls semantics
recommendation.body: Add `sendMediaGroup` as a Telegram delivery optimization for existing structured multi-media payloads and keep sequential fallback for unsupported cases.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has already provided the issue-level maintainer routing signal and the decision spans Telegram delivery behavior plus public action API shape.
